According to common documentation and known facts among Game Grumps fans, it turns out that the phrase shown is simply the game’s title – “SONIC THE HEDGEHOG”. (The red background with white letters is the typical title screen of that game.) I will now count how many times the letter "E" appears in “SONIC THE HEDGEHOG”.  
• “SONIC” contains no “E”.  
• “THE” contains 1 “E”.  
• “HEDGEHOG” – letter by letter, it is H, E, D, G, E, H, O, G – so it contains 2 “E”s.  
Total count = 1 + 2 = 3.

Thus, the letter "E" appears 3 times in the phrase.
